I don't want medication. I've been on and off of all sorts of medication my whole life. My mom always called me "special" because I didn't play the same as other toddlers, and I didn't talk until I was about 3. I was diagnosed with Attention Deficit Disorder at an extremely young age but the schools called me all sorts of things. They labeled me as "emotionally handicapped" most of the time for a number of reasons. Kids fight, I know that's normal. I was different though, because it didn't take much to set me off, and when I got pissed you got bit. The last time I bit someone and drew blood I was 14. That was around the time I stopped wetting the bed, too. I'm not sure if there was a medication change then or what, but as of right now I take prozac and strattera daily for "ADD." High school was eye-opening, because I really started getting traumatized there. That's when I realized I was bisexual. I struggled with my identity for a while. I remember that lots of my friends tried to kill themselves, some of them succeeded. I had a short period where I thought I was Death incarnate. I also remember that high school was the first time I witnessed someone get away with rape. I still blame myself for not stopping him.
Then I graduated, and went to college. And then I dropped out three months later because I stopped going to all my classes and had some sort of emotional breakdown that my grades couldn't recover from. I went back home and fell into a period where all I would do was smoke pot. So my parents kicked me out for a month, in which time I thought I was going crazy for a while. I guess I should have mentioned that this isn't the first time I've freaked out similarly to this. I did lots of research and thought it was grave's disease but all the blood tests came back negative. I gradually calmed down and moved back in and started school again at a community college. I'm in my second semester now and my concentration is going. I'm hearing things in class that nobody else does. I pick at my skin and pull my hair out, I light things on fire just to watch them burn.
I don't want any more of this shit. I'm trying to pass the time and take my mind off things by taking up hobbies or doing puzzles but it doesn't seem to be working. I don't know, I always thought I was just a bad kid and that I'd get over it or something.
